open_questions: Centroid inconclusive and centroid_all not_run leaves no-sky position confirmation; ground-based photometry at same aperture or high-resolution imaging would localise the dip but cannot be positively explained as a neighbour now.
Three transits and SNR ~10.49 limits depth and shape precision; additional transit monitoring to confirm flat bottom and stable depth.
Secondary candidate at phase 0.6851 snr 3.874 at depth 4264 ppm (depth_over_dip 0.26) is not significant now, worth checking at higher precision to rule out a small-star companion.
dossier.public_summary: A 1.9% dip repeats every 14 days on a small nearby M-dwarf with a flat-bottomed shape and no odd-even or secondary eclipse, as expected for a ~5 Earth-radius planet. No neighbour within a TESS pixel can produce the dip, and the duration fits the star. The two sectors disagree in depth because one is raw pipeline data and one is processed, which is a known calibration difference rather than a true change, leaving a planet as the best explanation.

reasons.why: Planet-sized 5.1 Rearth with undiluted depth 21380 ppm; below giant-planet threshold and far below stellar. Duration ratio 0.9533 matches central duration 2.097 h vs observed 1.999 h for a 0.3213 Rsun M-dwarf.

Negative V-score favours flat bottom over V-shape; favours planet over grazing binary. No odd/even difference (diff_sigma 0.4144, ratio 1.1) and no significant secondary (snr 3.874 vs best_brightening 3.117).
No star within 1 TESS pixel (21 arcsec) can cause the dip even with a full eclipse; closest that could needs 0.0427 eclipse at 35.2 arcsec. Contratio 0.139 low dilution and RUWE 1.075 no binary.

Raw sectors p_constant 0.01928 looks variable but source explains it as calibration between two pipelines with quarter coverage each, verging on differ_for_aperture effects. Individual transits scatter statistically consistent; proximity to noise limits does not create positive binary/blend evidence.
reasons.value: steady verdict with TESS-SPOC 13519 ppm (2356) vs QLP 23216 ppm (3409); transit p_consistent 0.0065 over 3 transits share 1.0
